boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of California-San Diego
boards.description: Named, under-21-safe campus destinations with currently published late or overnight availability; several have student or resident access limits.

cards.title: Open Desk
cards.subtitle: Price Center East, UC San Diego
cards.notes: Use the first-come, first-served window after 11 p.m. Monday through Thursday; bring a valid campus connection for this University Centers workspace.
cards.short_summary: A Price Center workspace with published availability until 2 a.m. on weeknights.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego University Centers lists Open Desk hours Monday–Thursday from 8 a.m. to 2 a.m., with no reservation needed from 11 p.m. to 2 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Monday–Thursday 8 a.m.–2 a.m.; 11 p.m.–2 a.m. is first come, first served without a reservation.

cards.title: The Courtroom
cards.subtitle: Earl Warren College, UC San Diego
cards.notes: For an overnight study session, Warren students can use this named lounge during its published 9 p.m.–7 a.m. access period every day.
cards.short_summary: An overnight Warren College study-lounge option for Warren students.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego lists The Courtroom at Warren College as available seven days a week from 9 p.m. to 7 a.m., for Warren students only.
cards.source_title: Where to Study on Campus | UC San Diego Student Services
cards.access_notes: Published access: seven days a week, 9 p.m.–7 a.m.; only Warren students can access it.

cards.title: JK Wood Lounge
cards.subtitle: Earl Warren College, UC San Diego
cards.notes: Keep this Warren College lounge in mind when you need an after-hours campus place; confirm building access conditions before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A named Warren College lounge listed with 24/7 availability.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego's campus study-locations page lists JK Wood Lounge with 24/7 hours.
cards.source_title: Where to Study on Campus | UC San Diego Student Services
cards.access_notes: Published availability: 24/7. Study-space hours may change during breaks or finals; check current access before travel.

cards.title: Beacon's Study Space
cards.subtitle: Room 101, Seventh College East Building #3
cards.notes: Head to Room 101 for first-come desk-style workspaces and chairs with attached laptop tables when a late independent-study stop is useful.
cards.short_summary: A Seventh College desk-style study room listed as open around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego lists Beacon's Study Space in Room 101 of Seventh College East Building #3 as 24/7 and first come, first served.
cards.source_title: Where to Study on Campus | UC San Diego Student Services
cards.access_notes: Published availability: 24/7, first come, first served. Check for break or finals-week changes before going.

cards.title: Blake 4 Lounge
cards.subtitle: Blake Hall, Revelle College
cards.notes: Revelle residents can use this named Blake Hall lounge for a late quiet stop; bring the residence access needed to enter the building.
cards.short_summary: A Revelle residence-hall lounge with published 24/7 resident access.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego lists the Blake 4 Lounge in Blake Hall as 24/7, accessible by Blake Residence Hall residents only.
cards.source_title: Where to Study on Campus | UC San Diego Student Services
cards.access_notes: Published availability: 24/7; restricted to Blake Residence Hall residents.

cards.title: Argo Residence Hall Lounges
cards.subtitle: Revelle College, UC San Diego
cards.notes: Argo residents have access to the hall's listed lounges around the clock, making this a residence-based option rather than a public study room.
cards.short_summary: A Revelle residential building whose lounges are listed as available 24/7 to its residents.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego lists Argo Residence Hall Lounges as 24/7 and accessible by Argo Residence Hall residents only.
cards.source_title: Where to Study on Campus | UC San Diego Student Services
cards.access_notes: Published availability: 24/7; restricted to Argo Residence Hall residents.

cards.title: Fleet Residence Hall Lounges
cards.subtitle: Revelle College, UC San Diego
cards.notes: For Fleet residents, the hall's listed lounges offer an around-the-clock place to continue reading or meet briefly with a neighbor after regular hours.
cards.short_summary: A Revelle residential building with resident-only lounges listed as 24/7.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego lists Fleet Residence Hall Lounges as 24/7 and accessible by Fleet Residence Hall residents only.
cards.source_title: Where to Study on Campus | UC San Diego Student Services
cards.access_notes: Published availability: 24/7; restricted to Fleet Residence Hall residents.

cards.title: Azad Hall Lounges
cards.subtitle: Eighth College, UC San Diego
cards.notes: Azad residents can use their building's listed lounges at night; treat it as residential space and follow the hall's access and community rules.
cards.short_summary: An Eighth College residence hall with 24/7 resident-only lounges.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego lists Azad Hall Lounges as 24/7 and accessible by Azad Hall residents only.
cards.source_title: Where to Study on Campus | UC San Diego Student Services
cards.access_notes: Published availability: 24/7; restricted to Azad Hall residents.

cards.title: Podemos Hall Lounges
cards.subtitle: Eighth College, UC San Diego
cards.notes: Podemos residents can rely on their own hall's listed lounges for an after-hours reset, reading session, or low-key conversation with hallmates.
cards.short_summary: An Eighth College residence hall with 24/7 resident-only lounges.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego lists Podemos Hall Lounges as 24/7 and accessible by Podemos Hall residents only.
cards.source_title: Where to Study on Campus | UC San Diego Student Services
cards.access_notes: Published availability: 24/7; restricted to Podemos Hall residents.

cards.title: Sankofa Hall Lounges
cards.subtitle: Eighth College, UC San Diego
cards.notes: Sankofa residents have a published 24/7 lounge option in their own building; use resident access and keep plans within normal residential guidelines.
cards.short_summary: An Eighth College residence hall with resident-only lounges listed as open 24/7.
cards.evidence_claim: UC San Diego lists Sankofa Hall Lounges as 24/7 and accessible by Sankofa Hall residents only.
cards.source_title: Where to Study on Campus | UC San Diego Student Services
cards.access_notes: Published availability: 24/7; restricted to Sankofa Hall residents.
